title: Tiny, cute pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pencil body, angled -->
  <g transform='rotate(-35 50 50)'>
    <!-- wooden/painted body -->
    <rect x='38' y='20' width='24' height='48' rx='3' fill='#FFC83D'/>
    <!-- lighter stripe along body for edge clarity -->
    <rect x='38' y='20' width='6' height='48' rx='3' fill='#FFE08A'/>
    <!-- dark side shade -->
    <rect x='56' y='20' width='6' height='48' rx='3' fill='#E0A21F'/>
    <!-- ferrule (metal band) -->
    <rect x='38' y='62' width='24' height='9' fill='#BFD3E6'/>
    <rect x='38' y='62' width='6' height='9' fill='#E8F2FB'/>
    <rect x='56' y='62' width='6' height='9' fill='#93AEC4'/>
    <!-- eraser -->
    <rect x='38' y='71' width='24' height='11' rx='5' fill='#FF8A9B'/>
    <rect x='38' y='71' width='7' height='11' rx='5' fill='#FFC2CB'/>
    <!-- sharpened wood tip -->
    <polygon points='38,20 62,20 50,4' fill='#F2C48B'/>
    <polygon points='38,20 50,20 50,4' fill='#FFE0B8'/>
    <!-- graphite tip -->
    <polygon points='45,11 55,11 50,2' fill='#6E5B8C'/>
    <polygon points='45,11 50,11 50,2' fill='#9A86BB'/>
  </g>
  <!-- cute face on the body -->
  <g transform='rotate(-35 50 50)'>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#3A2A5C'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#3A2A5C'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M46 45 Q50 49 54 45' stroke='#3A2A5C' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <circle cx='41' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#FF9AAF' opacity='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#FF9AAF' opacity='0.9'/>
  </g>
</svg>
